The '''Science Outpost''', also known as the '''Research Outpost''', was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Shaki Hamachil]] was the administrator of the facility while [[Shibb Nisshil]] worked as the [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]].<ref name="SWG" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Meatlumps]], a gang of fanatical technology-hating criminals and terrorists from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], placed a bomb in the Science Outpost. Fortunately, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who had infiltrated the group discovered the plot and defused the bomb before it could explode.<ref name="SWG:MEDS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Meatlump Explosive Device Sabotage}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Science Outpost was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
